• Because A wants everyone to experience and understand their own realities. 
• He wanted them to explore all the possibilities and become the best of themselves. 
• He basically wanted to compete with them and he was behind everyones power all along. 
• He decided to create the bridge between each world to transfer experience, knowledge and power from each universes to the other one. Along with memories, pain and suffering (As this is the ultimate lesson of life, he believes).
• This story unfolds as A experiences the first world after waking up again and again from the different possibilities.
